- The usage of turbo controls in any setting is strictly prohibited.
- The usage of emulators is banned.
- Video proof is required for each and every run (exceptions apply to certain times, see category rules).

- Multiplayer is banned unless stated otherwise in the category rules.
- Do not submit Twitch links as video proof.

**Bowser's Fury Speedrun Rules**

- Runs in the amiibo categories must forcibly use amiibo.

categories.name: 81 Shines
categories.rules:
**81 Shines Rules**

* Obtain all 81 Shines available without entering postgame (Max% No Postgame).
* Timer starts when the screen fades to black after selecting "New Game" or "Erase File" and ends on the final Bowser hit. 
* Bowser Jr. can be set to any level.
* Use of Amiibo is limited to the Amiibo sub-category.
* One player mode only.

categories.name: Itemless (MC)
categories.rules:
* Video proof is required for runs faster than 1 hour 53 minutes as of Feb. 4th, 2023.

**Itemless Rules**  
  
* Beat the game with no powerups. 
* If you accidentally grab a powerup, you must restart the level. 
* Timing starts when you select a character on a new file and ends once the flagpole poofs into clouds on 'The Great Tower Of Bowser Land'. 
* Use of Amiibo is not allowed.

**Allowed Powerups**  
* Temporary powerups are allowed, such as: **Mega Mushroom**, **Double Cherry** and **Invincibility Stars**, as well as the **Mushroom** powerup. (**Mushroom** is **ONLY** allowed to make the category more accessible to runners).   
  
**Restricted Powerups**  
* These include: **Super Bell, Tanooki Leaf, Boomerang Flower, Fire Flower, etc**.

**Multi-Character Rules**

* Use of multiple characters is allowed only when all characters are controlled by the same player.
* Submission of Itemless (MC) runs to Any% (MC) is allowed. However, submitting standard Any%/Itemless (1C) runs are not allowed for MC categories.

* This is for Super Mario 3D World only, not Bowser's Fury
* Video proof is required for runs faster than 2 hours as of Feb. 4th, 2023.

**Any% Warpless Rules**

* Beat the game without using warp pipes (1-2 and 4-2 warp pipes) and the final level in Worlds 1-8.
* Timing starts when you select a character on a new file and ends once you've grabbed the flagpole on 'The Great Tower Of Bowser Land'.

* Video proof is required for runs faster than 50 minutes for All Gold Flags Bowser Amiibo as of Feb. 4th, 2023.

**All Gold Flags Rules**

* Obtain all lighthouse shines available by collecting every island shine as fast as possible.
* Timer starts when the screen fades to black after selecting "New Game" or "Erase File" and ends on the start of the final golden flag cutscene. [Video Reference: https://imgur.com/a/7Ayf08Q]
* Bowser Jr. can be set to any level.
* Use of Amiibo is limited to the Amiibo sub-category.
* One player mode only.
* To assist in verification, it's suggested that you open the world map upon collecting the final golden flag to verify all gold flags are collected.

levels.name: World RTA
levels.rules:
Full video is required for your run to be accepted.  

Complete every level in the world chosen in a single-segment run, which includes Mystery House, Captain Toad and/or Letter levels. Stamp Houses are not required as they disappear upon first completion. In 100% runs, all stamps, stars, and golden flags are required. Use of amiibo is NOT allowed. 

This may be done on a completed file, and is more optimal.  

Time starts on level select. Timing ends when you grab the flagpole on the final level, or when you grab the final star if the final level is a Mystery House, Captain Toad, or Letter level. If you have a Super Bell when grabbing a flagpole, you must wait until the score appears before stopping the timer.

levels.name: World 1
levels.rules:
Full video is required for your run to be accepted. Submissions should be in In-Game Time (IGT). If you need more than one switch clip to record the full run, you may pause the game, then make your switch clip, and resume the run. Using snapshot mode in anyway is not allowed. Use of amiibo is NOT allowed.

When submitting, please use only In-Game Time as tracked by the game itself.  

You must submit a video of any form of your run. You may not add a 2nd player in for any reason except for in 1-4 100% runs.

- This is for Super Mario 3D World only, not Bowser's Fury

**Boss Blitz (Any%+) Rules**

- Collect 240 Stars and defeat Boss Blitz (11-12) with any character.
- If you have a Super Bell on when touching the last flagpole, you have to wait until you grab the pole, and the score numbers appear on you before you stop timing.

values.name: 380 Stars
values.rules:
* Video proof is required for runs faster than 4 hour 30 minutes as of Feb. 4th, 2023.

**380 Stars Rules**  
  
* Collect all 380 Stars.  
* Timer starts when you select character on a new file and ends once the 380th star is counted on the world map.  
* Using multiple controllers to control more characters is allowed but co-op with another person is not.  
* Use of Amiibo is not allowed.

- Video proof is required for runs faster than 9 hours as of Feb. 4th, 2023.

**100% Rules**

- Complete the game 100% with all 5 Stars on your save file. 
- This includes all Green Stars, Stamps, Gold Flagpoles, and all levels completed with all five characters. 
- Timing starts when you select a character on a fresh file and ends when the saving icon appears when you have 380 Stars and 85 Stamps
- Using multiple controllers is allowed.
- Use of amiibo is allowed (Just mention it in the desc.)
- Specify in the run description if you used any breaks, and when they were used.

**Breaks will be set like this**

- If the time passes 4 hours you get a 30 minute break and for every 4 hours onward you get an extra 15 minute break. A break starts when you enter the home menu with the intention of starting a break, and ends when you reopen the game.

- You don’t have to take a full break, and you’re not forced to take a break if you don't want to.

- Both start and end of each break should be timestamped in the run description.

**Break System**

- 4 hours = 30 minutes
- 8 hours = +15 minutes
- 12 hours = +15 minutes etc.

values.name: Normal
values.rules:
**Normal 100% Rules**
  
* Complete the game 100% with all 5 Stars on your save file. 
* This includes all Green Stars, Stamps, Gold Flagpoles, and all levels completed with all five characters. 
* Timing starts when you select a character on a fresh file and ends when you have 380 Stars and the last Stamp needed hits the Stamp Collection.
* Using multiple controllers is allowed in Normal 100%. 
* Use of amiibo is allowed (Just mention it in the desc.)
* If you use breaks during the run, select "TA" under run submission. If you don't, select "RTA"

**Breaks will be set like this** 

* If the time passes 4 hours you get a 30 minute break and for every 4 hours onward you get an extra 15 minute break, runners must go into the home menu and pause the timer.

* Runners don’t have to take their full break, and they’re not forced to take a break, the break time is optional.

* Both start and end of each break must be timestamped in the run description.

**Break System**

* 4 hours = 30 minutes
* 8 hours = +15 minutes
* 12 hours = +15 minutes etc.

values.name: True
values.rules:
**True 100% Rules**
  
* Complete the game 100% with all 5 Stars on your save file with ONLY one controller at all times. 
* This includes all Green Stars, Stamps, Gold Flagpoles, and all levels completed with all five characters. 
* Timing starts when you select a character on a fresh file and ends when you have 380 Stars and the last Stamp needed hits the stamp collection.
* Using multiple controllers is NOT allowed in True 100%. 
* Use of amiibo is allowed (Just mention it in the desc.)
* If you use breaks during the run, select "TA" under run submission. If you don't, select "RTA"

**Breaks will be set like this**
* If the time passes 4 hours you get an hour break and for every 4 hours onwards you get an extra 30 minute break, runners must go into the home menu and pause the timer.

* Runners don’t have to take their full break, and they’re not forced to take a break, the break time is optional. 

* No inputs are allowed to be performed while the timer is paused, and the timer will unpause on the first input after pausing. 

* Both start and end of each break must be timestamped in the run description.


**Break System**

* 4 hours =  1 hour
* 8 hours = +30 minutes
* 12 hours = +30 minutes etc.

categories.rules: Complete the level collecting all 3 stars, the stamp, and get top of the flagpole.

games.name: Super Mario 3D World + Bowser's Fury
games.rules:
**Super Mario 3D World + Bowser's Fury Speedrun Rules**

- The usage of turbo controls in any setting is strictly prohibited.
- The usage of emulators is banned.
- Video proof is required for each and every run (exceptions apply to certain times, see category rules).
- Anything impossible on an unmodified switch is concretely banned. This includes, but is not limited to, the usage of emulated amiibo, overclocking your console to increase speed, and applying any modifications to the game files.
- Anything impossible on an unmodified game is also concretely banned. This includes the usage of external skins (as of 6/21/23).
- Multiplayer is banned unless stated otherwise in the category rules.
- Do not submit Twitch links as video proof.

**Bowser's Fury Speedrun Rules**

- Runs in the amiibo categories must forcibly use amiibo.

levels.name: World 1
levels.rules:
Full video is required for your run to be accepted. Submissions should be in In-Game Time (IGT). If you need more than one switch clip to record the full run, you may pause the game, then make your switch clip, and resume the run. Using snapshot mode in anyway is not allowed. Use of amiibo is NOT allowed.

When submitting, please use only In-Game Time as tracked by the game itself.  

You must submit a video of any form of your run. You may not add a 2nd player in for any reason except for in 1-4 100% runs.

values.name: 380 Stars
values.rules:
* Video proof is required for runs faster than 4 hour 30 minutes as of Feb. 4th, 2023.

**380 Stars Rules**  
  
* Collect all 380 Stars.  
* Timer starts when you select character on a new file and ends once the 380th star is counted on the world map.  
* Using multiple controllers to control more characters is allowed but co-op with another person is not.  
* Use of Amiibo is not allowed.

values.name: Any%
values.rules:
* Video proof is required for runs faster than 1 hour 50 minutes as of Feb. 4th, 2023.

**Any% Rules**    

* Beat the game as fast as possible.  
* Timing starts when you select a character on a new file and ends once you've grabbed the flagpole on 'The Great Tower Of Bowser Land'. 
* If you have a Super Bell on when touching the last flagpole, you have to wait until you grab the pole, and the score numbers appear on you before you stop timing.  
* Use of Amiibo is not allowed.
* Multiplayer is not allowed.
* Submission of Itemless runs to Any% is allowed.

values.name: Any%
values.rules:
* Video proof is required for runs faster than 38 minutes for Any% No Amiibo runs as of Feb. 4th, 2023.
* Video proof is required for runs faster than 30 minutes for Any% Bowser Amiibo runs as of Feb. 4th, 2023.

**Any% Rules**  
  
* Beat the game as fast as possible  
* Timer starts when the screen fades to black after selecting "New Game" or "Erase File" and ends on the final Bowser hit. [Video Reference: https://imgur.com/a/BBsVlxJ] 
* Bowser Jr. can be set to any level.  
* One player mode only.

values.name: 100 Shines
values.rules:
* Video proof is required for runs faster than 1 hour and 30 minutes for 100 Shines No Amiibo runs as of Feb. 4th, 2023.
* Video proof is required for runs faster than 1 hour and 15 minutes for 100 Shines Bowser Amiibo runs as of Feb. 4th, 2023.

**100 Shines Rules**  
  
* Collect all 100 Cat Shines and defeat Bowser.  
* Timer starts when the screen fades to black after selecting "New Game" or "Erase File" and ends on the final Bowser hit. [Video Reference: https://imgur.com/a/BBsVlxJ]
* Bowser Jr. can be set to any level.  
* One player mode only.

values.name: Itemless
values.rules:
* Video proof is required for runs faster than 1 hour 55 minutes as of Feb. 4th, 2023.

**Itemless Rules**  
  
* Beat the game with any character and no powerups. 
* If you accidentally grab a powerup, you must restart the level. 
* Timer starts when you select a character on a new file and ends once you've grabbed the flagpole on 'The Great Tower Of Bowser Land'.    
* Use of Amiibo is not allowed.  
* Multiplayer is not allowed.
* Itemless Runs can be submitted to Any%
    
**Allowed Powerups**  
* Temporary powerups are allowed, such as: **Mega Mushroom**, **Double Cherry** and **Invincibility Stars**, as well as the **Mushroom** powerup. (**Mushroom** is **ONLY** allowed to make the category more accessible to runners).   
  
**Restricted Powerups**  
* These include: **Super Bell, Tanooki Leaf, Boomerang Flower, Fire Flower, etc**.

values.name: No Amiibo
values.rules: * Use of Amiibo is not allowed.

values.name: Bowser Amiibo
values.rules:
* Use of Bowser Amiibo is only allowed.  
* Use of other Amiibos are banned.
* Use of emulated Amiibos (via a hacked Switch) are banned.

values.name: 243 Stars
values.rules:
* Video proof is required for runs faster than 2 hour 43 minutes as of Feb. 4th, 2023.

**243 Stars Rules**  
  
* Collect all 243 stars accessible before the post-game (All Stars in Worlds 1-8). 
* Timing starts when you select a character on a fresh file and ends once you've grabbed the flagpole on 'The Great Tower Of Bowser Land'. 
* If you have a cat suit on when touching the last flagpole, you have to wait until you grab the pole and the score numbers appear on you before you stop timing.
* Using multiple controllers to control more characters is allowed but co-op with another person is not.  
* Use of Amiibo is not allowed.

values.name: 220 SS
values.rules:
* Video proof is required for runs faster than 3 hours as of Feb. 4th, 2023.

**220 SS Rules**  
  
* Beat both 3D World and Bowser's Fury as fast as possible with 170 Stars and 50 Cat Shines.  (220 Stars/Shines)
* Both games must be completed in a single RTA sitting.
* Timer starts depending on which game you play first (character select on 3DW or black fadeout in Bowser's Fury and ends on completing the second game (touching the flag at 'The Great Tower Of Bowser Land' or the final Bowser hit.)
* Use of Amiibo is not allowed.
* Multiplayer is not allowed.
  
**3D World Any% Rules**  
  
* Beat the game as fast as possible.  
* If you have a Super Bell on when touching the last flagpole, you have to wait until you grab the pole, and the score numbers appear on you before you split.  
  
**Bowser's Fury Any% Rules**  
  
* Beat the game as fast as possible with 50 Cat Shines.  
* Bowser Jr. can be set to any level.  
* One player mode only.

values.name: 480 SS
values.rules:
* Video proof is required for runs faster than 6 hours and 45 minutes as of Feb. 4th, 2023.

**480 SS Rules**  
  
* Collect All 380 Stars in 3D World and 100 Cat Shines in Bowser's Fury during. (480 Stars/Shines)
* Both games must be completed in a single RTA sitting.
* Timer starts depending on which game you play first (character select on 3DW or black fadeout in Bowser's Fury and ends on completing the second game (collecting the 380 Star on the world map or the final Bowser hit while having 100 shines.)
* Use of Amiibo is not allowed.
* Multiplayer is not allowed.
  
**3D World 380 Stars Rules**  
  
* Collect all 380 Stars in 3D World (Switch).  
* Multiple controller usage is allowed but multiplayer for the whole run is not allowed.  

**Bowser's Fury 100 Shines Rules**  
  
* Collect all 100 Cat Shines and Defeat Bowser.
* Bowser Jr. can be set to any level.  
* One player mode only.

values.name: Any%+
values.rules:
* Video proof is required for runs faster than 2 hours and 49 minutes as of Feb. 4th, 2023.

**Boss Blitz (Any%+) Rules**  
  
* Collect 240 Stars and defeat Boss Blitz (11-12) with any character.
* If you have a Super Bell on when touching the last flagpole, you have to wait until you grab the pole, and the score numbers appear on you before you stop timing.  
* Timer starts when you select a character on a new file and ends once you've grabbed the flagpole on 'Boss Blitz'.
* Using multiple controllers to control more characters is allowed but co-op with another person is not.

values.name: Boss Blitz – Itemless
values.rules:
* Video proof is required for runs faster than 3 hours as of Feb. 4th, 2023.

**Boss Blitz (Itemless+) Rules**  
  
* Collect 240 Stars and defeat Boss Blitz (11-12) with any character and no powerups.
* If you accidentally grab a powerup, you must exit, and retry the level. 
* Timer starts when you select a character on a new file and ends once you've grabbed the flagpole on 'Boss Blitz'.    
* Using multiple controllers to control more characters is allowed but co-op with another person is not.  
  
**Allowed Powerups**  
* Temporary powerups are allowed, such as: **Mega Mushroom**, **Double Cherry** and **Invincibility Stars**, as well as the **Mushroom** powerup. 
  
**Restricted Powerups**  
* These include: **Super Bell, Tanooki Leaf, Boomerang Flower, Fire Flower, etc**.  

* Use of Amiibo is not allowed.  
* Multiplayer is not allowed.

values.name: Normal
values.rules:
**Normal 100% Rules**
  
* Complete the game 100% with all 5 Stars on your save file. 
* This includes all Green Stars, Stamps, Gold Flagpoles, and all levels completed with all five characters. 
* Timing starts when you select a character on a fresh file and ends when you have 380 Stars and the last Stamp needed hits the Stamp Collection.
* Using multiple controllers is allowed in Normal 100%. 
* Use of amiibo is allowed (Just mention it in the desc.)
* If you use breaks during the run, select "TA" under run submission. If you don't, select "RTA"

**Breaks will be set like this** 

* If the time passes 4 hours you get a 30 minute break and for every 4 hours onward you get an extra 15 minute break, runners must go into the home menu and pause the timer.

* Runners don’t have to take their full break, and they’re not forced to take a break, the break time is optional.

* Both start and end of each break must be timestamped in the run description.

**Break System**

* 4 hours = 30 minutes
* 8 hours = +15 minutes
* 12 hours = +15 minutes etc.

values.name: True
values.rules:
**True 100% Rules**
  
* Complete the game 100% with all 5 Stars on your save file with ONLY one controller at all times. 
* This includes all Green Stars, Stamps, Gold Flagpoles, and all levels completed with all five characters. 
* Timing starts when you select a character on a fresh file and ends when you have 380 Stars and the last Stamp needed hits the stamp collection.
* Using multiple controllers is NOT allowed in True 100%. 
* Use of amiibo is allowed (Just mention it in the desc.)
* If you use breaks during the run, select "TA" under run submission. If you don't, select "RTA"

**Breaks will be set like this**
* If the time passes 4 hours you get an hour break and for every 4 hours onwards you get an extra 30 minute break, runners must go into the home menu and pause the timer.

* Runners don’t have to take their full break, and they’re not forced to take a break, the break time is optional. 

* No inputs are allowed to be performed while the timer is paused, and the timer will unpause on the first input after pausing. 

* Both start and end of each break must be timestamped in the run description.


**Break System**

* 4 hours =  1 hour
* 8 hours = +30 minutes
* 12 hours = +30 minutes etc.

values.name: 81 Shines
values.rules:
* Video proof is required for runs faster than an hour for 81 Shines No Amiibo runs as of Feb. 4th, 2023.
* No time threshold is available for 81 Shines Bowser Amiibo runs.

**81 Shines Rules**

* Obtain all 81 Shines available without entering postgame (Max% No Postgame).
* Timer starts when the screen fades to black after selecting "New Game" or "Erase File" and ends on the final Bowser hit. [Video Reference: https://imgur.com/a/BBsVlxJ]
* Bowser Jr. can be set to any level.
* Use of Amiibo is limited to the Amiibo sub-category.
* One player mode only.

- Video proof is required for runs faster than 9 hours as of Feb. 4th, 2023.

**100% Rules**

- Complete the game 100% with all 5 Stars on your save file. 
- This includes all Green Stars, Stamps, Gold Flagpoles, and all levels completed with all five characters. 
- Timing starts when you select a character on a fresh file and ends when the saving icon appears when you have 380 Stars and 85 Stamps
- Using multiple controllers is allowed.
- Use of amiibo is allowed (Just mention it in the desc.)
- Specify in the run description if you used any breaks, and when they were used.

**Breaks will be set like this**

- If the time passes 4 hours you get a 30 minute break and for every 4 hours onward you get an extra 15 minute break. A break starts when you enter the home menu with the intention of starting a break, and ends when you reopen the game.

- You don’t have to take a full break, and you’re not forced to take a break if you don't want to.

- Both start and end of each break should be timestamped in the run description.

**Break System**

- 4 hours = 30 minutes
- 8 hours = +15 minutes
- 12 hours = +15 minutes etc.
